scope: installed runtime, source/runtime parity, release regression, and B0QI field gate

regression.issue: A concurrent duplicate Stop could replace B's in-memory checkpoint with an older disk snapshot while C was judging, causing the single admitted delivery fence to be lost.
regression.fix: Reject a concurrent Stop occurrence before assigning its stale disk snapshot to the active controller state.
regression.behavior: The original active Stop retains its supervision admission and delivery; duplicate/replay occurrences remain rejected.
